verdicts.decision_note: The client requires separate payout handling for Seattle and Bay Area, establishing independent location payment behavior.
The reported one-payment-account Wix limitation materially conflicts with the client-confirmed separate-payout requirement.
The accepted setup changes the payment-isolation mechanism so each location uses a separate Wix site, account, and payment configuration; no prior value key becomes obsolete.
The target-explicit commitment confirms a feasible separate-site payment configuration and resolves the material payout conflict.
